verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a single platform-wide CLI reference (gcloud) that covers interactions with Google Cloud APIs. It also publishes REST references beyond flagship services, such as the Cloud Billing REST reference, and states that Cloud APIs are usable via REST or client libraries. The evidence does not show that every service has an equally complete, consistent reference. missing for 10: evidence of reference coverage and consistency across all services (not just billing/Cloud Run samples), independent or hands-on corroboration of reference quality and uniformity.

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
Use these Cloud APIs with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages.
An MCP server which operates on Cloud Run resources.
